name: Feodor
about: Feodor is 21 and a university student; he lives on his own in a small flat.
He usually gets up around eight and has coffee and porridge for breakfast.
His medicine is one vitamin D tablet every morning with breakfast.
On weekdays he goes to lectures and works on his laptop in the afternoon; three evenings a week he goes to the gym.
He usually takes this check-in call in the morning, before he leaves for the day.
